div.head: VIIa Atr 7
div.ab: ⁊ ealle gemænelice, gehadode ⁊ læwede, bugan to Gode georne ⁊ geearnian his mildse.
⁊ ealle gemænelice, gehadode ⁊ læwede, bugan to Gode georne ⁊ geearnian his mildse.
And ealle gemænelice, gehadode and læwede, bugan to Gode georne and geearnian his mildse.
Und alle, Kleriker und Laien, gemeinsam sollen sich ernstlich zu Gott wenden und seine Gnade verdienen.
And let all together, clergy and laity, turn eagerly to God and earn his mercy.
And all men with one accord, both clerics and laymen, shall zealously turn to God and obtain his mercy.
And all in common, ecclesiastics and laymen, are to turn eagerly to God and to deserve his mercy.
And all collectively, clerical and lay, are to submit to God wholeheartedly and deserve his mercy.

note.seg: This clause as a whole does not appear in the Latin version, but the ideas expressed in it are found in 1, 1; 2, 1.
